Ticket #20 — Team Invitation System

Difficulty: Easy

Practice Metadata

  • Interview format: Engineering ticket / existing-code debugging.
  • Primary skills: code navigation, state invariants, regression testing, implementation judgment.
  • Expected duration: 50–60 minutes.
  • AI assistance: Allowed in guided practice mode for explanations, hypotheses, test ideas, and focused hints; the candidate owns and explains every change.
  • Candidate objective: Trace the reported behavior through the supplied code, state an invariant, make a focused change, and prove it with a regression test.
  • Interviewer evaluation: Problem decomposition, code navigation, root-cause explanation, incremental implementation, and test evidence. See the shared interviewer rubric.

Context

You maintain invitations to a shared team workspace. A pending invitation contains an email, a role (viewer, editor, or admin), and an inclusive expiration time. Acceptance creates membership with that role. A periodic sweep can mark old invitations expired, but direct acceptance must enforce the lifecycle too.

Practice report

Create invitation i2 for late@example.com with now=10 and lifetime ttl=2. Without running the sweep, call accept("i2", 13) through the route adapter.

Observation Current starter Expected
Response status 409 409
Invitation status after rejection pending expired
Membership for that email Absent Absent

The reported defect is the saved lifecycle state after an expired acceptance attempt. For a separate fresh invitation with deadline 12, acceptance at 12 is valid.

Acceptance Criteria

  • Require an unused nonempty invitation ID, an email containing @, an allowed role, an integer creation time, and a positive integer lifetime. Invalid invitations must not create records or membership.
  • Do not invite an existing member or create another live pending invitation for the same email. A new invitation ID is allowed after expiry or cancellation.
  • Accept only a pending invitation at or before its inclusive expiration time. Success sets it to accepted and creates membership with the invited role once.
  • An acceptance attempt after the deadline marks a pending invitation expired and rejects the request without granting membership, even if no sweep ran.
  • Accepted, cancelled, expired, and unknown invitations cannot be accepted again. Cancellation can change a pending invitation only once.
  • The expiration sweep changes only pending invitations whose deadline has passed, returns newly expired IDs, and is safe to repeat.

Out of Scope

Use the supplied time integers, email checks, and single-workspace repository. Email delivery, authentication, and replacing the email validator are outside this ticket.

Investigation

Trace the direct late-acceptance case and compare it with the sweep. Add tests before, at, and after the inclusive deadline, including duplicate invitations, cancellation, and repeated acceptance. Check both saved invitation state and membership.
